responsibility: Owns the AVR port’s static catalog of architectures and MCUs derived from `avr-mcus.def`, together with architecture-level descriptive metadata shared by the compiler, driver-side generators, and documentation tools. It defines the canonical tables for core feature sets (`avr_arch_types`), texinfo descriptions (`avr_texinfo`), and recognized device names and per-device memory/layout properties (`avr_mcu_types`), and also provides helper reporting such as listing supported core architectures for diagnostics and user messages.
